item.title: Describe a Family Photo
item.prompt_text: Imagine a photo of two people in your family. Where are they in the photo? Say who they are, what you can see near them, and one thing a person is doing.
item.target_grammar: These are; next to and near; present continuous for actions.
item.fluency_objective: Point out the people first. Use one short sentence for each detail.
item.pronunciation_objective: Give the main action word a little more stress, for example holding in 'She's holding a cup'.

cues.text: Name two people in the photo.
Say where they are or what is near them.
Say what one person is doing.

item.model_opening: These are my sister and my uncle.
item.model_answer: These are my sister and my uncle. They are in front of our old house. My sister is next to the door. She is holding a small red cup. My uncle is sitting by the window.
